segments.text:
V. 20.
The Father ſheweth him all things that himſelf doth—A Proof of the moſt intimate Unity. And he will ſhew him—By doing them. At the ſame Time (not at different Times) the Father ſheweth and doth, and the Son ſeeth and do••. Greater Works—Jeſus oftener terms them Works, than Signs or Wonders. 〈◊〉 they were not Wonders in his Eyes. Ye will marvel—So they did, when He raiſed Lazarus.
